content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-123","Title":"set_todo_test_plan cannot resolve durable EXEC-TODO without execution-state row","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["mcp__mcpserver.set_todo_test_plan fails with KeyNotFoundException \u0027Execution TODO ... was not found\u0027 because TodoExecutionService.SetTestPlanAsync only loads workspace-local .mcpServer/todo-execution-state.json and FindTodo matches TodoId plus WorkspacePath in that file. It never falls back to the durable TODO provider used by plugin workflow.todo.query. Byrd plan expansion dual-writes EXEC-TODO-* into both stores, so after reboot, path renorm, or lost/empty execution-state the durable TODO remains visible while typed test-plan/status/checkpoint helpers treat it as missing. Observed for EXEC-TODO-011 in TruckMate: query succeeds; set_todo_test_plan fails.","Triage group: triage-group-fa318a5b021e97cd","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- Given a durable EXEC-TODO visible via workflow.todo.query or the TODO provider for the same workspace, set_todo_test_plan with that todoId succeeds and returns the updated status (e.g. TestReady when unitTestsDefined is true).","- When .mcpServer/todo-execution-state.json is missing, empty, or lacks the EXEC-TODO row but the durable TODO still exists, set_todo_test_plan reconciles or rehydrates execution state from the durable TODO instead of returning not found.","- FindTodo resolution is robust to workspace-path normalization differences that still map to the same registered workspace (no false not-found after reboot when only path form differs).","- Failure messages distinguish durable-TODO-missing from execution-state-only-missing so operators can tell dual-store desync from a truly unknown id.","Implementation notes:","- Root path: FwhMcpTools.Todo.SetTodoTestPlan -\u003E ITodoExecutionService.SetTestPlanAsync; error text matches TodoExecutionService KeyNotFoundException at FindTodo after LoadStateAsync (state path = {workspace}/.mcpServer/todo-execution-state.json).","- CreateTodosFromPlanAsync dual-writes: todoService.CreateAsync (durable) plus TodoExecutionRecord in state.Todos. SetTestPlanAsync/UpdateStatusAsync and related helpers only consult state.Todos; they do not call ITodoService.GetByIdAsync.","- Preferred fix: on miss in FindTodo, resolve via durable TodoService for that workspace; if found and Byrd/EXEC-shaped, rehydrate a TodoExecutionRecord into state (or rebuild minimal TestDesign/TestReady record) then apply the test plan and save state. Alternative: hydrate execution state at workspace open/server start from durable EXEC-TODO-* rows.","- Also audit path normalization used when writing WorkspacePath on create versus the path passed by MCP tools after reboot; FindTodo is case-insensitive but requires equal normalized paths.","- Regression coverage: durable TODO present \u002B execution-state absent/missing row -\u003E set_todo_test_plan succeeds; both present -\u003E existing behavior; neither present -\u003E clear not-found."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
